# kcore_volume_snapshot (Resource)

Volume snapshot (`kctl create volume-snapshot`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_volume_snapshot" "data" {
  volume = kcore_volume.data.name
  name   = "web-data-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `volume` (String)

### Optional

- `consistency` (String)

### Read-Only

- `protected` (Boolean)
